TITLE: Follow-Up on Dilhas Consulting Contract Renewal

From: Nasgo Kesloren  
To: Finance Lead  
Subject: Request for Further Discussion  

The contract with Dilhas Consulting, valued at $6.5M and assigned to cost center BT-9828-L, remains a key component of our ongoing operations. As this vendor has been engaged since the inception of the arrangement, and given that I joined Zastama Industries in 2020, I believe it is important to ensure that our evaluation process considers both long-term performance and strategic alignment. The preliminary report has been reviewed and appears to support continued engagement, but I would like to propose a more in-depth discussion with the finance lead and key stakeholders to explore potential adjustments. Please let me know a suitable time to proceed.

---

From: Finance Lead  
To: Nasgo Kesloren  
Subject: Re: Request for Further Discussion  

I agree that Dilhas Consulting warrants a more detailed evaluation given the size of the contract and the duration of engagement. The $6.5M agreement under cost center BT-9828-L requires careful consideration, especially in light of our current fiscal planning. I will coordinate a meeting for next week to gather input from relevant parties and review the latest financial and operational data. Your insights on the vendor’s performance since 2020 will be valuable in this context. I will circulate the calendar invite shortly.

---

From: Nasgo Kesloren  
To: Finance Lead  
Subject: Re: Request for Further Discussion  

Thank you for agreeing to the meeting. I will prepare a summary of the key points from the report and highlight how the work of Dilhas Consulting has supported our strategic objectives since 2020. I will also include an overview of how the cost center BT-9828-L has been managed over the same period. I’ll send this information ahead of the meeting so that all attendees have the necessary context. Let me know if there are any additional documents or data you would like included.

---

From: Finance Lead  
To: Nasgo Kesloren  
Subject: Re: Request for Further Discussion  

Appreciate the prompt. I’ll note your points and ensure the meeting agenda reflects the need to evaluate both performance and fiscal impact. Please send the summary to my team and me as soon as it’s ready. We should also consider any vendor trends or benchmarks that might inform our decision. Let’s keep the focus on strategic alignment and value for Zastama Industries.
